description: This Swift source file defines the MenuSessionsInjector class, which manages the dynamic creation and updating of macOS menu items related to session monitoring, node management, usage statistics, and session control actions within a menu bar application.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for injecting, updating, and managing session-related menu items in a macOS NSMenu, including session summaries, nodes, usage, costs, and session control actions, with support for background data loading and cache management.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a specified NSStatusItem, attaching delegate and starting cache refresh and control channel observation.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Prepares the menu when it is about to open, injecting session info and nodes, and triggering cache refresh if needed.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Cleans up after menu closes, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: startControlChannelObservation
methods.description: Begins observing the control channel’s state changes.

methods.name: observeControlChannelState
methods.description: Tracks control channel state with observation and triggers UI updates on changes.

methods.name: handleControlChannelStateChange
methods.description: Handles updates when the control channel’s state changes, refreshing cache and updating menu.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Delegates menu update requests to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides confinement rectangle for the menu, delegating to original delegate if available.
